text:
sarah: Found 7 archived snapshots in prod missing CMEK (cmek-id) metadata after last night's deploy. No decrypt errors, but headers absent.

mike: Which objects and uploader?

sarah: gs://redwood-archives/region-eu/*/snap-*.tar.gz, ~2026-03-21 02:00-03:30 UTC. uploader=backup-uploader@infra svcacct.

encops-bot: Alert: encryption-meta-missing detected (7 objects) in gs://redwood-archives/region-eu. Correlation=a1b2c3d4.

james: Did we change RBAC on uploader? @priya?

priya: I pruned a broad archive:admin binding and replaced with archive:writer + kms:encrypt scoped roles. I didn't realize metadata write is a separate permission.

mike: Check multipart completion and KMS grants TTLs — finalization writes cmek header.

priya: KMS audit: ephemeral grants g-9f3/g-9f4 created ~01:50Z, lastUse ~01:55Z, revoked ~02:05Z by rotation automation. Overlaps upload window.

mike: Likely race: grant revoked before CompleteMultipartUpload wrote cmek-id, leaving object with provider-managed encryption only.

sarah: Quick checks: gsutil ls -L shows "Encryption: NONE" and no x-goog-meta-cmek-id. For S3: aws s3api head-object -> look for ServerSideEncryption / SSEKMSKeyId.

oncall: INC-2026-4389 opened. Scanning archive prefix now.

oncall: Scan: 7 objects total; 3 are within retention and can be re-uploaded; 4 older snapshots need compliance decision.

alex: Objects encrypted with provider keys ≠ CMEK. Some tenants require CMEK for compliance. We must notify affected customers and offer re-encryption.

priya: Triage summary: (1) RBAC prune removed metadata-write capability, (2) grant-prune automation revoked ephemeral grants during finalization, (3) finalize path lacks atomic cmek attach fallback.

mike: Immediate actions: (A) pause grant-prune for backup key while in-flight multipart ops exist, (B) revert/remove the RBAC prune that removed metadata-write, (C) run integrity scan + re-rewrite/re-encrypt fix for fixable objects.

james: I have a rewrite script ready; it copies and explicitly sets CMEK via KMS client. Will run with a temporary grant.

priya: I'll create a temporary long-ttl grant for the remediation job and log it. Then revoke post-fix. PR to restore minimal metadata-write role created (#4321).

sarah: Add to incident checklist: validate object encryption headers and KMS grant TTLs after RBAC or rotation changes. Also run: python tools/check_archive_cmek.py --start 2026-03-21T00:00 --end 2026-03-22T00:00 --fixable-only and post results to INC-2026-4389.

alex: Postmortem actions: CI gate to validate metadata on deploys touching uploader/KMS IAM, telemetry alert when daily % of archived objects missing cmek-id > threshold, runbook update to validate cmek before deleting multipart temp parts.

mike: Filing follow-up PRs: #4323 (grant-prune guard), #4325 (CI metadata check). Owners: priya, mike, james.

sarah: Thanks team. ETA for cleanup ~2026-03-21T12:00Z UTC. Will reconvene for 15m postmortem in 30m. :lock: :white_check_mark:
